summary: feat: model selection picker + USD budget cap
description:
Umbrella for the model-selection feature. Implementation plan:
docs/model-selection/IMPL-model-selection.md. Spec:
docs/model-selection/BRD-model-selection.md.

Ships BRD §12 phases 1–2:
  Phase 1 (C1–C4): server-side default switch + USD cap + sync
  timer + CI guard. Addresses the cost concern on its own; no UI.
  Phase 2 (C5–C7): pro picker UI + chat attribution + announcement
  banner.
  Phase 3 (C8): post-launch telemetry review.

Hard rules:
  - C1 (schema + tier limits) and C2 (CURATED_MODELS map) land
    before C3 (route integration).
  - C4 (sync timer + CI guard) ships with C1–C3 — without it, the
    first slug bump after launch can take down /api/query (BRD
    §5.4: computeCost throws on missing pricing).
  - C5 (picker UI) before C7 (banner links to /settings).

Closes when all eight children close.
